name: kiln_inside
purpose: Occlusion culling (G3d) on the kiln as one clustered mesh: the cameras of kiln_near that look at the outside, and ones inside the dome, where the near shell hides most of the 5 million triangles. No Cycles truth: judged against the same scene without occlusion culling. Local only (see kiln.json). Run with --lod --lod-clusters [--lod-occlusion].
